title: Additional requirements for conventional construction in Seismic Design Category D.
officialText: Structures of conventional light-frame construction in Seismic Design Category D as determined in Section 1613, shall conform to Sections 2308.12.1 through 2308.12.8, in addition to the requirements for Seismic Design Category B or C in Section 2308.11.
